title: Query-Aware Token Budgeting for Efficient Late-Interaction Visual Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.07262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Late-interaction visual document retrievers preserve fine-grained page evidence by storing many token embeddings per page, but the resulting storage and query-time interaction costs make large-scale deployment expensive. Pooling document tokens before indexing offers a natural remedy, yet static pooling must decide which visual evidence to preserve before the query is known. We study an alternative: a heavily compressed hot-path index generates candidates, after which query-aware token budgeting operates on the original token sets of the shortlisted pages. We formulate this stage-two selection as a budgeted MaxSim coverage problem, show that a clipped version is monotone submodular, and compare coverage-only, cluster-guided, token-wise, and marginal-gain policies. translated_title: 面向高效迟交互视觉文档检索的查询感知令牌预算分配
translated_abstract: 迟交互视觉文档检索器通过为每页存储大量令牌嵌入来保留细粒度的页面证据，但由此产生的存储与查询时交互成本使得大规模部署代价高昂。在建立索引前对文档令牌进行池化是一种自然的补救方法，然而静态池化必须在查询未知的情况下提前决定保留哪些视觉证据。我们研究了一种替代方案：先用高度压缩的热路径索引生成候选页面，随后由查询感知的令牌预算分配在入围页面的原始令牌集合上进行操作。我们将这一第二阶段的选择问题形式化为带预算约束的MaxSim覆盖问题，证明了其裁剪版本具有单调次模性，并比较了仅覆盖、聚类引导、令牌级和边际增益等策略。在使用ColModernVBERT的十个ViDoRe任务上，直接的静态池化将排序第五处的宏平均归一化折扣累积增益从无压缩时的0.6309降至0.4738……
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段查询感知令牌预算分配方法，先通过高压缩索引筛选候选页面，再在入围页面的原始令牌集上求解带预算约束的MaxSim覆盖问题，从而在大幅降低存储与查询成本的同时保持视觉文档检索精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage query-aware token budgeting approach that first generates candidates via a heavily compressed hot-path index and then solves a budgeted MaxSim coverage problem on the original token sets of shortlisted pages, preserving visual document retrieval accuracy while drastically reducing storage and query-time interaction costs.
